description: This Java class defines the entity for PaymentAuthorization, representing provider-specific authorization details within a payment system. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping, including fields for payment intent reference, provider info, authorization IDs, status, raw response data, and timestamps, with methods for lifecycle callbacks and accessors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback executed before the entity is persisted; sets createdAt and updatedAt timestamps to current time.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle callback executed before the entity is updated; updates the updatedAt timestamp to current time.
